description: Revoke an S3 key; S3 refuses it within 15 seconds. Idempotent and safe to retry. Needs a management key (mtblm_) or the login of an owner or admin; an API key gets management_key_required. org_id is optional: a key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.

access_key_id.description: the S3 key's access key ID, from list_s3_keys

name: revoke_s3_key
